---
name: release-note-writer
description: Use when the user asks release-note-writer to draft a public release note. Do not activate for internal commit messages.
---

# release-note-writer

Write for existing users in calm, factual Japanese. Start with the user-visible
outcome, then list compatibility and migration actions. Never use `革命的`,
`絶対安全`, or unsupported performance claims. Keep the final text under 400
Japanese characters and use exactly these headings: `概要`, `互換性`, `移行`.

If compatibility information is missing, stop and ask for it instead of
inventing an answer.
